news.title: Big US banks restrict third-party AI agents from customer accounts
news.summary: JPMorgan Chase, Citi, Bank of America and other large US banks are limiting outside AI agents to read-only access, so they can't log in or move customer money. The banks are building their own controlled AI tools instead.

news.title: OpenAI's always-on dots agents take overnight on-call pages for engineers
news.summary: OpenAI's dots are always-on agents that handle on-call incidents, watch channels and open investigation threads. One engineer used his dot from the ChatGPT app to deal with a 3 a.m. page without getting out of bed.

news.title: NVIDIA App update turns on AI agent control by default, prompting privacy warnings
news.summary: NVIDIA App 11.0.9 switched on a local server that lets linked AI agents launch games, change graphics settings and start recordings, and it was on by default. Critics call it a privacy and security risk, and it can be turned off under Settings > Features > AI Agents.

news.title: OpenUI 1.0 lets AI agents answer with interactive maps, charts and forms
news.summary: Thesys released OpenUI 1.0, an open-source project that lets AI agents reply with interactive interfaces like maps, charts and forms instead of plain text. It works with any model and supports React, Vue and other frameworks.

news.title: Self Labs ships Agent Vault so agents can pay and log in without real credentials
news.summary: Self Labs released Agent Vault, which gives AI agents stand-in tokens for logins and payments and swaps in the real credentials only at the moment of use. Users set spending caps, allowed merchants and a kill switch.

news.title: Ledger adds Agent Intent: AI agents propose, your hardware wallet approves
news.summary: Ledger introduced Agent Intent at its Paris event: AI agents can propose actions such as payments, but each one has to be approved on the user's hardware wallet. Private keys stay with the user, and the beta is free on compatible devices.

news.title: Figma Specs feeds design decisions to coding agents over MCP (open beta)
news.summary: Figma Specs keeps written design decisions next to the frames and code they describe, and passes that context to coding agents over MCP. The open beta is rolling out now.

news.title: GSA hosts a government hackathon on MCP servers and AI agents
news.summary: The US General Services Administration has posted a government hackathon focused on Model Context Protocol servers and AI agents.
